response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with over 15 years in the field and a diverse technical background. He has recent, relevant experience with AI agent infrastructure and cloud technologies. However, his experience is at the Senior and Staff Engineer level, which is a significant gap from the Director-level Principal role described. His resume lacks evidence of the high-level strategic planning, cross-organizational influence, and customer advisory responsibilities that are central to this position.
strengths: Exceeds the 15-year experience requirement with a broad background across web, mobile, and infrastructure.
Recent experience in AI-agent infrastructure and tooling, showing an up-to-date skillset.
Demonstrates strong initiative and leadership potential through founding an open-source project and creating developer tools.
concerns: Significant seniority gap, with experience topping out at the Staff Engineer level, not the required Director-level Principal.
Lacks demonstrated experience in setting high-level product strategy or advising strategic customers.
AI experience seems focused on infrastructure and tooling rather than building and shipping core AI-powered products or platforms.
